top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a mature, continuous discovery chain from incretin physiology and proglucagon processing to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and receptor agonists with replicated randomised outcomes in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation and the citation scope (physiology and active peptide enabling a new therapeutic class) are well supported, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
